xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3459

plan.title: UAT Shell residuals after #3421: dest-form plant of authz, kill-switch, and approved-scope

narratives.Description: AppSec on 82bd37f3 found two HIGH UAT Shell classification residuals and one MEDIUM mint-path asymmetry. Residual dest forms after #3421 still classify empty and allow write-shaped Shell that can plant .deft/authz or a kill-switch. Residual Shell writers can also forge .deft/approved-scope while Write is denied.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator under active UAT, I want residual write-shaped Shell dests that plant authz, kill-switch, or approved-scope to classify as settings deny, so that #3421 cannot be bypassed by dest forms the harvest missed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Extend dest-form harvest in packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts for GNU g* coreutils prefixes (ginstall, gcp), gh/glab/hub clone, iwr -OutFile, fsutil, cmd copy, tsx/ts-node, npm pack --pack-destination. 2. Under UAT fail-closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell targeting protected dests; classify kill-switch and .deft/approved-scope pathish as settings deny. 3. Add vitest in packages/core/src/authz and a brief CHANGELOG security note, then verify with the authz vitest suite. Do not re-do #3421 named peers (install/cp/git clone/Set-Content/echo).
narratives.Overview: Do not re-do #3421 named peers (install/cp/git clone/Set-Content/echo approved-scope). Do not write an exploit cookbook. Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT. Ordinary /tmp dests stay unclassifiable.

items.title: Residual dest forms cannot plant authz or kill-switch

narrative.Acceptance: Given active UAT, when residual bins write into .deft/authz/** or plant .deft-directive-disable / .no-deft-directive, classify returns settings deny, not unclassifiable allow. Dest parsing covers GNU g* coreutils prefixes (ginstall, gcp), gh/glab/hub clone, iwr -OutFile, fsutil, cmd copy, tsx/ts-node, npm pack --pack-destination when dest is protected. Unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT is fail-closed. install / cp / git clone / Set-Content stay settings-denied. /tmp dests outside those paths stay unclassifiable.

items.title: Shell cannot forge approved-scope while Write is denied

narrative.Acceptance: Given active UAT, when residual Shell writers target .deft/approved-scope/**, classify is settings deny matching Write. A forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint.
Given the classify changes, when vitest runs packages/core/src/authz, residual bins vs already-denied peers are covered. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a brief security note with no exploit cookbook.

intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: classify.ts dest harvest and its matching classify/incident-regression matrices already exceed FILE_SIZE_REVIEW_TRIGGER_LINES. Residual dest forms after #3421 must land beside the existing harvest, not in a split module. CHANGELOG.md already exceeds the trigger; this slice only adds the #3459 security note.
